title: First Offensive - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: First Offensive in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Abbest Cave - defeat the Chromatic Abbest

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: First Offensive is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases damage on the opening turn.

sections.title: How to Get First Offensive
sections.content: Location: Abbest Cave - defeat the Chromatic Abbest.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
